Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Represents a position in PostgreSQL's write-ahead log, as the <code>pg_lsn</code> type holds it.

```csharp
public readonly struct PgLsn : IComparable<PgLsn>, IComparable, ISpanFormattable, IFormattable, ISpanParsable<PgLsn>, IParsable<PgLsn>, IEquatable<PgLsn>
```

The text form is two hexadecimal numbers, the high and low 32 bits, as in <code>16/B374D848</code>.
[ToString()](/api/ankus.pglsn/#member-a509a0e35182b570) writes them without padding, as PostgreSQL 13–18, Npgsql and rust-postgres do; PostgreSQL 19
pads the low half to eight digits. Parsing accepts both forms, and so does every supported PostgreSQL version.

Implements: [IComparable&lt;PgLsn&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.icomparable-1), [IComparable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.icomparable), [ISpanFormattable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.ispanformattable), [IFormattable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iformattable), [ISpanParsable&lt;PgLsn&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.ispanparsable-1), [IParsable&lt;PgLsn&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iparsable-1), [IEquatable&lt;PgLsn&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iequatable-1)
